title: How Free Hosting Gets Your Code On the Internet

sections.heading: Everyday Analogy
sections.body:
Think of hosting like renting table space at a market.

Your website is your shop. Without a table, no one can visit. A hosting platform is the market that gives you a table, power, and a street address.

Free tier hosting means the market lets you start with a small table for free to show your work.

sections.heading: Why It Exists
sections.body:
Before hosting, your code only runs on your laptop. No one else can see it.

Hosting platforms fix this. Static site publishing is for simple sites with fixed files like HTML and images. Edge deployment means your site is copied to servers close to users around the world, so it loads fast.

Git-based deployment means when you push code to GitHub, the platform auto-publishes it.

sections.heading: What Can Go Wrong
sections.body:
Free tables are small. What fails first if usage grows 100x?

Your free limits break. Hosting is where your app lives. Deployment is moving new code there.

On free tiers, you may hit sleep, slow loads, or shutdowns. Edge copies can show old files if not updated. And JAMstack platforms are great for static sites, but not for apps needing always-on servers.

steps.narration: You build a site, but it only lives on your laptop.
You push to Git, which triggers a deployment.
The hosting platform builds and hosts your files.
It copies them to edge servers near users.
Users visit quickly from the closest copy.

quiz.q: What is the difference between hosting and deployment?
options: Hosting is where your app lives, deployment is moving code there
Deployment is free, hosting is not
quiz.why: Hosting is the home, deployment is the move. Your save shows platforms that host after you deploy.

quiz.q: What fails first if usage grows 100x on a free tier?
options: You hit free limits: sleep, caps, slow loads, or shutdowns
Edge servers make it faster forever
quiz.why: Free tiers are small demos. Huge traffic hits limits first, as free hosting is for showcasing, not big scale.

quiz.q: What is edge deployment best for?
options: Running code only on your laptop
Copying your site close to users for fast loads
quiz.why: Fly.io in your save advertises global edge deployment to run apps closer to users.

extra: Free tiers often require credit card verification and have cold starts after inactivity
